title: Maa Baa
overview: Two herds of sheep, one with curly wool and the other with straight wool. They speak different languages, MAA and BAA. They live separated from each other and none of them dared to meet anyone from the other side. They both believe that the other ones have deadly dangerous wool. But the curiosity of two newborn sheep leads them to each other and after a scary meeting, they realize that they are just the same, except that they have different hair styles.
